title: An AK-47 being shot // has distinctive metallic kalashnikov-esque report // punchy sounding w/ distant trailing reverb
author: serøutōnin--deprivəd
desc:
An AK-47 being shot w/ distinctive punchy kalashnikov-esque report

another round of weapon firing sound effects. these are supposed to replicate the distinctive sound an AK-47 makes when fired. this is variant 3 out of 3. I had a lot of fun making these. I took some raw gunshot sound effects I recorded, pitched and layered them on top of each other to create the initial sound, added the sound of a door slamming shut for more emphasis, and the sound of keys jangling for the sound of the bolt slamming shut. and then for this one, I added the sound of distant thunder to give the report more of an 'oomph.' overall, it was pretty fun to make. I'm satisfied with the result.

as always, credit will always be appreciated - though it's not required at all. if you do choose to credit me, please do so under the name "serøutōnin//deprivəd", or alternatively "seroutonin//deprived".

ily guys <3
